headlines: Stocklake: US Non-Farm Payrolls 165k vs 29k previous (released 13:30 UTC)
Stocklake: fear and greed 20 (extreme fear), VIX 26.4, SPY RSI 33.5, QQQ RSI 26.9
QQQ +1.96%, IWM +0.49%, gold GLD -1.17% on the session
Stocktwits trending: DKNG -27%, MU +8%, NVDA +6%, OKLO +18%, IREN +19%, ABNB +9%

rumors.text: Posters say SPY is near 742-747 intraday and call it bulls vs bears, with some expecting 747 and others another 2% drop
rumors.why: Crowd doubts that the bounce will hold, so a fade is possible if buyers tire

rumors.text: A poster says SMCI is a screaming buy with a short squeeze imminent at about 4x earnings
rumors.why: A squeeze would lift SMCI, but this is one promotional post

rumors.text: Posters say the market is a house of cards and to trade it, not own it
rumors.why: Widespread distrust of the rally can cap upside and sharpen reversals

plays.reason: Extreme fear and oversold RSI with a rebound under way and a crowd that distrusts it, which can feed a squeeze
plays.catalyst: Payrolls reaction and unwinding of bearish hedges into the close

readings.whats_new: SPY has risen to about 739 (+0.83%) from 734 (+0.16%) last hour, led by QQQ +2% and chip names like MU and NVDA. Stocklake confirms payrolls at 165k vs 29k previous. Stocktwits sentiment edged up to 49 from 44 but posters stay skeptical and choppy. Reddit was blocked and web search found no same-day coverage.
